topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Well, I reckon the lord's plans are as unpredictable as the summer storms. Just when the wheat's high and the barn's full, the bailiff brings word that the old manor's to be split, each room to new masters. It's like dividing the common land, isn't it? I've always known the walls of the manor, just as I know the furrows of my fields. Now, strangers will walk those halls, each with their own title and rights. It's a strange notion, like sowing a field with seeds you've never seen. The village will speak of this for seasons to come, I wager. Only the saints know what harvest this change will bring.
